Good morning,

Please find attached the agenda for Thursday's board meeting. The finance committee will present the audit results, and we will vote on the proposed changes to the bylaws.

Board members who cannot attend in person may join by phone. The dial-in number is 1-800-555-0142, access code 4471.

Best regards,
Margaret Ellis
Board Secretary

labels.notes: "Please find attached" is a formal stock phrase, not an error.
